deviations_and_corrections: The strategy doc's B10 row said the donor's prebuilt/userland was not in the pinned checkout; it is tracked at the pinned commit (sparse checkout excluded it). Row corrected in this change.

The first run of the scanner found a bug through a test (a '"' character literal opened a string); the scanner was rewritten as one pass over comments, character literals, include lines and strings; the literal search first looked only in __cstring and reported 5 `static const char[]` strings as missing; it now searches the whole file and names the section; the constant search first lacked movn and orr-bitmask decoding and the nearby-sum hint.
One hook constant (0x1882f0908) was decoded by hand from the raw words at 0x4254-0x425c, independently of the decoder.
No mutation pass was run on inspect_dylib.py: it is an inspection aid whose output was checked by hand for the rows the note quotes, not a gate.
limits: The dylib is not a reproduced build of inject.c; absence of a string is not absence of code, presence is not proof of the same behaviour.
Nothing was executed or run on the phone; B9 and B7 are unchanged.
Whether the 20F66 addresses are right for this phone's cache is decided by IOS-013 and by the library's own run-time check, not here.
